section_summary.extract_value: This section presents convergent validity results for the BAS-2, showing that body appreciation was significantly associated with self-esteem and life satisfaction. Notably, the relationship between body appreciation and BMI differed by gender: negative association in women and positive in men, with a significant correlation (r = .12) found between body appreciation and BMI² in men. A positive correlation between body appreciation and age was observed in men but not women.
